Gideon, the first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, when you posted that the gate kiosks were offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant and both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, per the channel, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You wrote "both lanes working as of Aug 3, 11:07."

Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, messages from 2026-08-03, 10:42 to 11:08 AM. The channel's timestamps are as shown there. I haven't checked them against the company time zone.
